notes: Original Urban files are read from the external checkout by the optional parity test, not copied into this repository. The single production implementation namespaces its symbols through pra_internal.h; house_transform additionally retains its pre-transform plan. Room capacity is raised to 16 in the Urban types (the original eight-slot structure can overflow). No hallway is added to no-hallway layouts. Original algorithm output parity is tested against separately compiled Urban files plus full current ApeSDK toolkit; the 3D adapter repairs corner door portals without changing raw original room records. Yard driveways and metric meshes are new adapters. Production house_plusminus limits width rejection to 512 attempts and returns generation failure for degenerate SDK PRNG cycles; the unmodified original can hang at seed (20600,18). Seed (130,10) is an explicit ten-room regression. Original completing reference outputs remain exact.
source_of_truth: ApeSDK urban/ component uses the existing toolkit math, vectors and allocation directly (APESDK_URBAN_ONLY). wasm-z builds these sources through its pinned submodule.
